d_and_a.source: 10-K 0001652044-26-000018, us-gaap:Depreciation (depreciation of property and equipment only, as returned by deskstack; total D&A incl. amortization may be higher)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 15.1% (402,836/350,018); fade gradually as the base grows, rationale is law of large numbers.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: held at FY2025 actual 32.0% (129,039/402,836); higher D&A from heavy capex offsets operating leverage.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. effective rate; FY2025 implied (158,826 pretax vs 132,170 net income) ~16.8%, 10-K 0001652044-26-000018.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 actual 5.2% (21,136/402,836) rising as the FY2024-25 capex build depreciates.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 actual 22.7% (91,447/402,836) easing toward 20% as the AI infrastructure build moderates.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + assumed beta 1.1 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = 9.8% cost of equity; debt ~48.5B vs equity far larger so ~4% weight of after-tax debt at ~5%; WACC rounded to 9.5%. Beta 1.1 is an assumption, not looked up.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and near long-run nominal US GDP growth.

net_debt.source: deskstack derived net_debt = total debt 48,543 - cash 30,708 - marketable securities 96,135; 10-K 0001652044-26-000018 (negative = net cash)
